## Product Refinement
To be completed during product refinement — include problem description, proposed solution, and acceptance criteria for implementation.

## Tech Refinement

### 1. Owner Notes
To be completed by the issue owner before the first refinement session — include technical considerations, approach options, and any open questions for discussion.

### 2. Discussion Notes
To be completed during refinement session(s) — create a new section for each refinement the issue goes through.

### 3. Outstanding Questions
To be completed at the end of each refinement session — the issue remains in refinement as long as there are questions on this list.

### 4. Agreed Approach
To be filled out when refinement is complete and the issue has moved into the ticket-writing stage.
